xgk5qbvx.variantName: Christmas Tree World 6ft Foresta Pine Christmas Tree
xgk5qbvx.sourceDescription: Looking just like a freshly chopped tree, the Foresta Pine is a personal favourite in the Christmas Tree World family. Beloved for its dense, two-tone green foliage, this is one of our bushiest traditional trees available. Combining a mixture of PE plastic moulded branches and classic PVC tips, you get a super realistic Christmas tree that will last for years to come. Picture shows 7ft tree in our range. What's more, the Foresta Pine comes with pre-attached pinecones and feathered 'bottle-brush' pine needles, giving the tree a charming, chunky appeal. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Product Features • Size: 6ft • Number of Branch Tips: 1027 branch tips • Tree Width: 110cm diameter • Foliage colour: Two-tone green with decorative pine cones • Realistic look: A stunning mix of PE/PVC and large bottle brush branch tips • Easy assembly: Hinged branches • Sturdy base: Folding metal stand with plastic tips to prevent scratching • Fire resistant: Fire retardancy certified • Indoor use only: The trees construction will rust in rain • Height measured from the floor • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

sp4qyry1.variantName: HOMCOM Set of 2 Prelit Christmas Trees with Dual Colour LEDs and Remote - Green
sp4qyry1.sourceDescription: Enhance your entryway or living space with this set of 2 pre-lit Aspen Fir artificial Christmas trees anchored in decorative pot bases. Featuring realistic molded PE outer foliage and dense PVC inner tips, each tree offers 11 dual-colour lighting modes via remote control—allowing adjustments without getting up. Battery powered and flame-retardant tips, they bring safe, symmetrical charm for young and fluffy friends. ● Set of 2 Aspen Fir trees anchored in golden decorative pot bases provides a balanced, symmetrical accent ● Molded PE outer tips capture the true texture and natural look of real evergreen boughs, complemented with Inner PVC foliage for dense and full foliage ● Pre-lit LEDs feature 11 dynamic lighting functions switching between warm white and multicolour ● 5m remote control allows you change lighting modes without getting up ● Cordless and compact size design offer placement flexibility away from power outlets and small spaces ● Flame-retardant PVC leaves and strong steel trunk ensure home fire safety ● Molded PE tips naturally retain their shape, requiring minimal manual tip shaping ● Sectioned trunk structure for space-saving storage ● Colour: Green ● Light Colour: Warm White / Multicolour ● Material: PE, PVC, Steel, PP ● Overall Dimensions: Φ75 x 120H cm ● Pot Base Dimensions: Φ18 x 26H cm ● Tip Count: 147 (Per Tree) ● Light Count: 110 LEDs (Per Tree) ● Power Supply: Battery Box Powered (Requires 3 x AA Batteries, Not Included) ● Remote Control: 5m Range (Requires 1 x Battery, Included) ● Item Label: 83C-341V01GN ● Note: Approx. 10-15 minutes of minimal tip shaping tree recommended to achieve full natural density. Warning: for decoration only. Keep away from open flames, heaters and other heat sources. Ensure the product is stable before use. Keep small parts and packaging away from children. Stop using if damaged. 1 Northampton Cross Logistics Park Northampton Cross Road Northampton NN4 9FH

qyqgtp5e.variantName: Christmas Tree World 4ft Majestic Dew Pine Christmas Tree
qyqgtp5e.sourceDescription: One of our favourite Christmas trees, the Majestic Dew Pine is bushy with a realistic, full foliage. It also comes with a hinged branch construction for easy assembly. The most unique part of our Majestic Dew trees are the acrylic droplets that are delicately placed on the end of the bottle brush style branch tips. This means you get a stunning 'freshly cut' artificial Christmas tree that appears sprinkled in morning dew. A real festive delight! This tree is perfect for those that want a unique realistic Xmas tree - but without the cost that comes with plastic moulded branch tips. Picture shows 7ft tree in our range. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase.
